content.comment_body: Hello, I have a [product_name] with [version_no]. For the first time, I set the network IP address, subnet mask, and gateway correctly, managed to connect to the PC, and successfully uploaded and downloaded the program. However, when I navigated to diagnostics via the hardware menu and tried to return to the main menu, several items disappeared. Now, my menu on the text display only shows setup, network, and diagnostics. Please assist.

It seems you have switched to operator mode, which disables some menu items. To restore all options, you need to switch to administrator mode. Go to setup > switch to ADMIN. You will be asked to enter the password. If you haven't changed it, the default password is [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced missing menu items on a [product_name] with display after configuring the network and accessing diagnostics. Some regular menu options vanished from the main menu, leading to confusion. The issue was due to being in operator mode instead of administrator mode.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects all main menu items to always be visible and accessible during system operation, without needing specific knowledge about user modes.
